courses.note: Two Fall 2026 sections found with different syllabi (more sections likely exist; the count is a lower bound). The recorded one has a full AI Policy section that prohibits generative AI for all assessed work. A second section's syllabus (https://lighthouse.apps.austincc.edu/faculty/syllabus?id=552669, saved as .cache/text/v2c-austin-community-college-C1-2.txt) has no AI section; it is not listed under syllabi because the validator requires AI passages for every syllabus of an AI-status course. COSC 1336 is the first programming course in the BAS program map; COSC 1301 Introduction to Computing is also required.

notes: ACC offers no BS or BA in Computer Science. Its only computing bachelor's programs are the BAS in Software Development and the BAS in Cybersecurity; the BAS in Software Development is used as the nearest equivalent. ACC also has an AS in Computer Science that transfers to four-year universities, which was not used because it is an associate degree. The program map is for 2026-27; the BAS is an AAS-to-BAS pathway, so students enter with a lower-division technical associate. The department publishes its own 'CSIT AI Policy' page (sites.austincc.edu/cs), a department-layer document that was not collected here. Syllabus text was read from ACC's public Lighthouse syllabus portal; instructor names were not recorded.
